title: Storm Ripper

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Storm Ripper is the upgraded form of Ripper using Iolite. Like all upgraded-weapons that use Iolite, they gain 10 lightning damage and their hit effect has a 25% chance to apply Chain Lightning.
An upgraded Ripper will NOT keep its upgrade level when it is modified using gemstones.

Introduction. Storm Ripper is the upgraded form of Ripper using Iolite. Like all upgraded-weapons that use Iolite, they gain 10 lightning damage and their hit effect has a 25% chance to apply Chain Lightning.
